preferred_auxiliary_bytes: strictly below each corresponding base file; lower is better if quality acceptable
motion_update: every frame, half-pixel, bilinear resize of frozen E grids, no temporal subsampling
support: 4 or 8 pixel conservative cells; grouped all-frame intersection, no group crossing new or old anchors
sender_lookahead: span minus one frames for mask intersection; whole-segment packaging remains offline
safety: zero decoded support outside corresponding represented-motion pixel-safe set
phase1: seven video1 E-fusion variants; report all including failures, no ROI-specific edits
phase2: common low-rate candidate on video2 and video3; E/F fusion controls; common parameters
rate_selection: Pareto tradeoff, prefer below-base actual files, do not fill the cap
evaluation: frozen external reliable textured source support; full/quadrants/coral plus source fidelity and uncompressed arrays
user_rate_clarification: 50k is an absolute bound only, not a target; best below base bitrate
